svg.title: AIcoach - Night Range - Landing

text.tspan: AI
coach
ONE SWING.
WHAT A COACH
WOULD SAY.
Film one swing down the line with your phone. AIcoach
finds the fault, shows where it comes from and how sure
it is — then gives you one drill for the rest of the
bucket.

svg.text: Private by default. Unsaved swing clips are deleted after analysis.

text.tspan: IT SHOWS YOU THE FRAME,
NOT A SCORE.
Every result points at the moment it happened. Address
and impact side by side, body lines drawn on the swing,
the measurement printed on the frame — and how sure
AIcoach is about it.
hips toward the ball,
address to impact
“It may feel like you stay down,
but at impact your hips have
moved toward the ball.”
IT TELLS YOU WHEN
IT DOESN'T KNOW.
A coach who guesses is worse than no coach — you end up
grooving the wrong thing. AIcoach refuses bad video, says
when it finds nothing it can verify, and puts a
confidence band on every measurement.
Weight appears to move
toward the trail side
at the top.

svg.text: hips hidden by a golf bag

text.tspan: Bad angle, body out of frame, too dark? No guessed
fault — the reasons, each linked to the step of the
filming guide that fixes it.
If your swing has none of the three faults, it says so.
At most one observation, labelled unverified, with no
drill.
High, medium or low on every measurement. When the
impact frame is partly hidden, you see “low” — and what
to film better.
FILM. UPLOAD.
HEAR IT.
It fits between two buckets. Prop your phone, hit one
shot, upload from the phone browser. A 10-second clip is
analysed in under two minutes.
Down the line, phone at hand height on your bag,
2.4–3.7 m behind the hands line. 120 fps if your
phone has it. Whole body and club in frame.
One swing per clip, mp4 or mov, up to 15
seconds. Tick “Save to my swing library” only if
you want to keep it.
The fault, the frame it shows up in, the fault
chain behind it, one drill and one mobility
exercise — and a coach to ask about it.
THREE FAULTS.
CHECKED BY RULES, NOT GUESSED.
Hips move toward the ball between address and impact, measured
as a share of your body height.
Your posture angle changes between address and impact — you
stand up out of the shot.
The hands move out toward the ball from the top. Read from the
hand path, so confidence is capped at medium.

svg.text: Anything else: “No verified fault found” — plus at most one observation, labelled “Unverified — confirm with a coach”.
BRING ONE SWING TO THE RANGE TONIGHT.

text.tspan: AI
coach

svg.text: A practice tool — not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
